summary: Round-2 confirmation of fix commit 280d452. All round-1 minor items are correctly addressed with no regressions: the dead java.time.Duration import is gone (zero references remain), and the three new tests reference only symbols verified to exist with matching signatures. Both affected test classes are green — FunnelStepExecutorTest 10/10 and FunnelExecutionEngineIT 14/14 (0 failures/errors/skipped), with the new sweepRespectsBatchCapOldestFirstAndWarnsOnSaturation IT present and passing. Test sources compile clean. No new issues found.

round1ItemsAddressed.item: Remove dead Duration import in FunnelExecutionEngine.java
round1ItemsAddressed.evidence: grep for 'Duration' in FunnelExecutionEngine.java returns 0 matches.

round1ItemsAddressed.item: IT sweepRespectsBatchCapOldestFirstAndWarnsOnSaturation (batch cap + nextRunAt asc + saturation WARN)
round1ItemsAddressed.evidence: Engine sweep() sorts ASC by nextRunAt, .limit(batchSize), and warns when due.size() >= batchSize via LOG_SWEEP_SATURATED. With @DynamicPropertySource sweep-batch-size=2 and 3 staggered-nextRunAt rows, the query returns the 2 oldest (2 >= 2 fires WARN); newest left running/pending. Test present in result XML, passes.

round1ItemsAddressed.item: no-PII IT also attaches StepExecutor logger and exercises >4096 trim-WARN path
round1ItemsAddressed.evidence: Test attaches LoggerFactory.getLogger(StepExecutor.class), seeds payload with x.repeat(5000), asserts LOG_TEXT_TRIMMED present and PII absent from both loggers. StepExecutor.LOG_TEXT_TRIMMED / MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=4096 confirmed; logged fields are lengths only, no payload. Passes.
Asserts CONTINUE and verify(subscriberService).removeTag(PROJECT_ID, SUBSCRIBER_ID, 'vip'); SubscriberService.removeTag(String,String,String) signature matches.

BotTokenInvalidException(String botId, String reason) ctor matches; StepExecutor maps BotTokenInvalidException -> StepResult.fail('invalid_bot_token') (Outcome.FAIL); test asserts FAIL + reasonCode invalid_bot_token. Passes.
